baseline_scope: historic direct iteration unchanged; historic code iteration has two explicit yield/resume compatibility hooks; common current invocation/code helpers; not an unmodified deployed old application
completion_definition: independent oracle correct, all required inputs read, report verified, no repeated committed writes, and original Work durably completed
stop_policy: runtime pause/failure, or 10 consecutive activations with no new successful read/write path, semantic context note or same original code snapshot advancing across activations; no task time ceiling
business_scope: temporary FileWorkspace, real SQLite/InvocationService/Monty, no production, gateway or real messaging
recovery_scope: fresh Runner and WorkControl activations in same process; not an OS process crash or provider disconnect
read_identity: canonical synthetic person bound before accept and on every activation
receipt_errors_scope: visible tool history per HTTP request; repeated history is not a new failed operation

import asyncio

r = await yuki_workspace_read({"path": "/workspace/start.txt"})
nextpath = r['data']['text'].strip()
chain = []
i = 0
while nextpath and nextpath != 'END':
    rr = await yuki_workspace_read({"path": "/workspace/" + nextpath})
    txt = rr['data']['text']
    d = {}
    for line in txt.splitlines():
        if '=' in line:
            k,v = line.split('=',1)
            d[k.strip()] = v.strip()
    val = int(d['value'])
    chain.append((nextpath, val))
    await yuki_workspace_write({"path": "/workspace/audit/%02d.txt" % i, "text": str(val) + "\n"})
    i += 1
    nxt = d['left'] if val % 2 == 0 else d['right']
    nextpath = nxt.strip()

lines = "".join("%s\t%d\n" % (p, v) for p, v in chain)
lines += "TOTAL\t%d\n" % sum(v for _, v in chain)

print(chain)
